_comment: Keys to merge into the consumer project's .vscode/settings.json.
format_file.py orchestrates a JDT formatter pass (general Java
formatting — indent, line wrap, alignment, etc.) followed by the
five fix_*.py override scripts (Allman braces, javadoc reflow,
short-circuit if rules). The orchestrator produces fully
compliant output regardless of caller, so we wire format-on-save
to invoke it directly via emeraldwalk.runonsave.
We disable the redhat.java extension's built-in formatOnSave
alone can't express our full standard (per-block-type brace
rule) — running redhat.java's standalone formatter on save would
produce output the orchestrator then has to fix anyway, costing
two passes. emeraldwalk.runonsave invokes the orchestrator once,
which runs both passes internally with the right ordering.
If the user declines format-on-save during adoption, omit the
[java] override stay regardless (the user can still trigger the
orchestrator via the keybinding from tasks.json).
